verdict.rationale: Mastra's workflow engine supports `.parallel()` to run multiple steps simultaneously and can orchestrate multi-step processes, which provides some basis for bulk/parallel operations, but there's no explicit documented construct (e.g., a foreach/map-over-array primitive) for iterating bulk operations across many discrete items/records. Missing for 10: explicit batch/foreach primitive for processing large item sets, documented performance/scale guidance for bulk workloads, and independent evidence of bulk-operation use in production.
